trajectory_summary: The call moved smoothly from a cooperative, pre-warmed customer to a locked appointment with minimal resistance — the shape is mostly flat-to-positive with the only friction around bill/kWh confusion. The rep executed the mechanical script well (address, credit, appointment) but left the customer's explicit motivation and bill pain unused as leverage.

observed_outcome.quote: Eleven is good. What day? What Wednesday, we said. Right? Wednesday at eleven. Yep.
observed_outcome.reasoning: A specific day and time (Wednesday at eleven) was agreed by both sides, but the appointment is conditioned on the customer successfully texting over his bill, which was not captured live — per Ion's rule this renders the set fragile/tentative despite the locked time.

primary_coaching_focus.topic: Reason-for-call never used as the pitch anchor
primary_coaching_focus.quote: I have a new a new addition I put on. I like to have that connected.
primary_coaching_focus.why: The entire call exists because of this stated need, yet it's acknowledged and dropped rather than driving the bill/kWh conversation or the appointment framing until the very last minute.

key_moments.quote: I have a new a new addition I put on. I like to have that connected.
key_moments.stewart_read: This is the customer's stated reason for the whole call — an existing solar owner wanting the new addition connected — and the rep files it with 'Okay. Awesome.' instead of building on it.

key_moments.quote: The last one the last one was 80 some dollars. One before that was $2.20 something, and the one for that was $2.30 something.
key_moments.stewart_read: Customer just disclosed a bill that spiked into the $200+ range before dropping to $80 — a striking swing worth surfacing — but rep didn't reflect it, just kept pushing for a kWh figure.

key_moments.quote: I don't want anything. And I have electric heat and air conditioning.
key_moments.stewart_read: Electric heat and AC is a strong solar-fit signal (high consumption base) that the rep never acknowledges or uses to reinforce the value of an add-on system.

key_moments.quote: Do you remember, like, how many kilowatts it was?
key_moments.stewart_read: Rep correctly recognized dollar figures alone aren't the design input needed and tried to get kWh, but customer couldn't provide it — the ask itself was right, follow-through (photo via text) was the correct fallback.
